documents.notes: The relation has no explicit license tag, so OHM's published CC0 default applies. Its own start_event says 'Extent of Russian expansion in 1689'. The polygon is not treated as authoritative: it is pinned, spatially controlled and combined with primary documentary evidence. It notably excludes Azov, so it is not used after the 1696 acquisition.
